description: This source file defines a React-like component 'ForecastStrip' using Lightning.js framework for rendering a horizontal forecast list in a weather app frontend. It includes props, state, computed properties, methods, and a template for UI layout, handling navigation and selection of forecast items.

methods.name: ensureVisible
methods.description: Adjusts scroll position to ensure the focused forecast item is visible within the viewport.

methods.name: setFocusIndex
methods.description: Sets the focus index to a specified value, bounded within the items array length.
